title: Bugatti Chiron in the Night Studio on a Rainy Night
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
description:
Welcome into the quiet comfort of the Night Studio, where a rosso red Bugatti Chiron rests beneath low light while rain streaks down the glass, blurring the distant city into soft glowing colors. For two peaceful hours, you are enveloped in ambient electronic music only, carried by warm synth pads, a soft deep bass, and a gentle beat. It is a soothing haven made for you to focus on your work, sink into studying, or simply relax.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
